s02F639.name: Unused. Draw 8 tiles at a fixed screen position
summary: Only reached from the unused wrapper ADDR_02F58C (an enter-castle animation variant that is never selected).
Draws 8 16x16 tiles at X = $C0, Y = $70 plus per-tile offsets, into OAM $0300+$B0..$CC. Purpose unclear.

s02F6B8.name: Draw 3x4 tile block with offset
summary: Draws 12 16x16 tiles (tile $A5, property $21) in a 3 column by 4 row block at OAM $0200+$B0.
Parameters: [$00]: upward offset in pixels (0-$30). Used by the enter-castle animation; probably a door or gate that slides up and down.

s02F759.name: Enter-castle animation and cluster sprite loop
summary: $02F759: other variant of the enter-castle animation (timer [$18D9] starts at $7F). Plays sound $0F at timer $76 and $10 at timer 8,
then draws 8 16x16 tiles whose frame (0-3) follows the timer; tiles with OAM index >= $80 go in the $0200 buffer. Frames 3+ are X-flipped.
$02F808: long-call wrapper that runs all 20 cluster sprite slots. $02F810 loops X = 19..0 and calls the routine for [$1892,X] through Ptrs02F825.
Cluster sprite arrays: [$1892] number, [$1E16]/[$1E3E] X low/high, [$1E02]/[$1E2A] Y low/high, [$0F4A] timer/animation.

Ptrs02F825.name: Pointer table: cluster sprites, fading Boos
summary: $02F825: 9 pointers to cluster sprite routines, indexed by the cluster sprite number in [$1892,X].
$02F83D: cluster sprite 7. A group of Boos that jump between two layouts ([$18BA] bit 0 selects the offsets at [$1E66]/[$1E52] or [$1E8E]/[$1E7A]),
while a timer [$190A] counts $FF to 0. The timer sets a fade level 0-8 in [$190B] (fade in at $FF-$E0, solid, fade out at $40-$20, hidden below $20),
applied as a palette transparency effect (CODE_038239). Boos bob by 1 pixel every 8 frames and hurt Mario on contact (CODE_02FE71).

s02F8FC.name: Table: Sumo Bro flame Y offsets

SumoBroFlameTiles.name: Sumo Bro lightning flames
summary: Pointer table index 6. A flame left by the Sumo Bro; [$0F4A,X] is its lifetime timer (timer / 8 picks one of 4 animation frames).
Tables first: Y offsets, tiles and frame order. $02F91C: update (count timer down, animate, test contact, draw). $02F940: draw 2 16x16 tiles.

s02F9AE.name: Sumo Bro flame: contact with Mario
summary: Every 4th frame per slot, if the flame timer is $10 or more: builds a hitbox (X + 2, width $0C, Y + table, height $14) and checks it against Mario.
Star: the flame disappears. On Yoshi: Mario loses Yoshi (CODE_02A473). Otherwise Mario is hurt. $02F9F5 is also used by the Boo contact check.

s02FA02.name: Table: castle flame animation masks and OAM

CastleFlameGfxProp.name: Castle candle flames
summary: Pointer table index 5. Four flickering flames drawn at the last 4 OAM slots ($F0-$FC in the $0300 buffer), positioned by the layer 2 scroll [$1E]/[$20].
The animation counter [$0F4A,X] advances randomly. A tile at X >= $F0 is duplicated at OAM $03EC with X bit 8 set so it also shows at the left screen edge.

s02FA84.name: Table: Boo ring angle offsets
summary: 16-bit angle offsets (512 = full turn) of each Boo in a ring: $0000, $0028, ..., $0168 (10 entries).

s02FA98.name: Ring of Boos on a circle
summary: Pointer table index 4 (probably the circling Boo ring). Ring data in [$0FAE]-[$0FBC] indexed by ring number [$0F86,X]:
9-bit angle [$0FAE]/[$0FB0], center X [$0FB2]/[$0FB4], center Y [$0FB6]/[$0FB8], despawn flag [$0FBA], level sprite index [$0FBC].
The angle advances by [$0F4A,X] unless sprites are locked. The ring despawns when its center is far off screen. Each Boo = center + radius $50 * sin/cos
(CircleCoords and the hardware multiplier). $02FBB0: every 4th frame test contact with Mario.
